targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE passed) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) FROM soak_validation_runs WHERE status='completed'
SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict='pass') / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) FROM chaos_simulation_runs
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operational_drift_reports WHERE drift_exceeds_threshold = true
SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict='pass') / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) FROM replay_recovery_runs
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telemetry_continuity_reports WHERE continuity_ok = true
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chaos_failure_events WHERE component='worker' AND outcome='recovered'
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, AVG(memory_growth_mb) as memory, AVG(telemetry_gap_rate)*100 as gap_pct FROM soak_validation_runs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict='pass') as pass, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict='fail') as fail FROM chaos_simulation_runs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, drift_type, AVG(drift_pct) as avg_drift FROM operational_drift_reports GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
